cap: an old ropes course, fenced off. found it mid-run through the park. love stumbling on secret finds like this, even though the abandonment’s a little sad. had half an urge to climb it.
a butterfly outside my IBM window
my pencil sketch of a cat
they look behind at every step
somebody built a hobbit house for the neighborhood little library
one bay, one ocean, one guy and his infinite thoughts
self-assured morals plaque. the irony. evil ai.
names, loves, and forevers carved into impermanent bamboo. duke gardens.
